## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the VWAP overnight grinder strategy can capture edge by identifying and riding the momentum of overnight price movements, leveraging the information in the overnight session to inform trading decisions in the regular trading hours.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves identifying overnight price movements and using them to inform trading decisions during regular trading hours. Specifically, the strategy will use the overnight high and low prices to determine the direction of the trade and the entry and exit points.
